description: This file contains the implementation of the ProvisioningCriteriaAssembler class, which is responsible for parsing JSON input to create and validate ProvisioningCriteria objects, including related domain objects such as ProvisioningCriteriaDefinition and LoanProductProvisionCriteria. It coordinates data retrieval from repositories, validation of range overlaps, and assembling complex provisioning criteria structures.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaAssembler
classes.description: A service class that parses JSON to assemble ProvisioningCriteria objects, validate ranges, and manage associations with related domain entities.

methods.name: parseLoanProducts
methods.description: Parses a JSON array of loan products from the input, or retrieves all loan products if none specified.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Checks for overlapping provisioning criteria definitions to ensure data consistency.

methods.name: fromParsedJson
methods.description: Main method that converts JSON input into a fully populated ProvisioningCriteria object, including its definitions and related loan products.

methods.name: createCriteria
methods.description: Creates a new ProvisioningCriteria object from JSON, setting creation metadata.

methods.name: createProvisioningCriteriaDefinitions
methods.description: Constructs a ProvisioningCriteriaDefinition object from JSON data, linking to category and account entities.
